summary_1line: During a night battle, both armies illuminate the battlefield with thousands of lamps, creating a radiant spectacle as fighting resumes and Arjuna devastates Kaurava ranks.

image_candidates.scene_text: Thousands of oil lamps held by soldiers and mounted on chariots, elephants, and horses transform the dark battlefield into a blazing sea of light.
Drona in golden armor stands at the front of the illuminated Kaurava army, shining like the midday sun amid the glow of countless lamps.
Gods, Gandharvas, and celestial beings gather in the sky above the glowing battlefield, watching the armies clash beneath them.
